user.title: Select Setup Mode
user.description: Choose how to set up your Philips Avent Baby Monitor+. You can automatically extract the camera's localKey via a one-time cloud login, or enter your localKey manually.

lan.title: LAN-Only Setup
lan.description: Connect directly to the camera over your local network (TCP 6668). If you used Automatic Local Key Extraction, your Device ID and Local Key are pre-filled below.

cloud.title: Tuya Account & App Signing Setup
cloud.description: Sign in once to extract your camera's Device ID and Local Key (or use Cloud MQTT). Provide either the local path to the Baby Monitor+ APK (to auto-extract cert & t_s.bmp token) or the pre-extracted cert SHA-256 and bmp_token.

data.apk_path: Path to Baby Monitor+ APK (optional if cert & bmp_token provided)
data.cert_sha256: APK Cert SHA-256 Colon-Uppercase (optional if APK provided)
data.bmp_token: Decoded t_s.bmp Token 64-hex (optional if APK provided)
data.mfa_code: Email MFA Code (leave blank on first attempt to trigger email)

mfa.title: Email MFA Verification
mfa.description: A 6-digit verification code has been emailed to your account. Enter it below to complete authentication and extract your camera's localKey.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to authenticate with Tuya Cloud. Check your credentials and region.
error.invalid_signing_config: Provide either a valid APK file path or both Cert SHA-256 and bmp_token.
error.invalid_mfa: Invalid or expired MFA verification code.

abort.already_configured: This baby monitor is already configured.
